paper_id: Knowledge-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Requirements Development_ A Vision
title: Knowledge-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Requirements Development: A Vision
motivation: 现有多智能体系统专注于代码开发，缺乏对需求工程的专门设计，导致RE任务仍需大量人工投入
problem_framing: 将自动化需求开发定义为由六个专业智能体协作完成elicitation、analysis、specification、validation等任务，并以artifacts pool驱动工作流
key_insight: 每个智能体需配备功能、预定义动作和知识三要素，通过artifacts pool的状态变化触发协作
method_signature: 六智能体+artifacts pool的多智能体协同框架，模拟RE中的interviewer、end-user、analyst等角色
evaluation_criteria: 中间产物和最终SRS的质量
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 当前仅有一个案例研究，方法泛化性待验证
evidence_for_taste: primarily focus on code development and lack the design
just directly assign agents to act as roles
do not clearly define the software engineering knowledge
the quality of both the intermediate artifacts and the final SRS is satisfactory
We conducted a case study to validate the practicality
thinking_moves: 把RE中的角色职责分配给不同的LLM智能体
用artifacts pool状态变化驱动智能体间协作
将黑板机制引入多智能体系统设计
模拟人类专家的推理过程为智能体注入领域知识
从代码开发的多智能体系统扩展到需求工程领域
cites_own_work: MARE: Multiagents Collaboration Framework for Requirements Engineering
An evaluation of requirements modeling for cyberphysical systems via LLMs
extraction_notes: 作为vision paper，缺乏详细的方法实现描述和系统性的实验评估；关于KGMAF的实际效果主要依赖案例研究的定性展示
